answer: Each new identity must be vouched for by an established agent, like a lantern lighting only after the jetty is built, so attackers must burn real stake and waiting time per fake identity. Agents earn trust by staking collateral and passing periodic proof-of-work challenges that scale in difficulty toward a network-wide zenith of verified reputation. Fabricating a thousand sybils costs a thousand collateral locks plus sustained challenge effort, making the attack economically irrational while honest agents pay almost nothing. This model fits agent Agent0205's threat model.
